true_answer: We will often be working with functions with finite domains, so this kind of picture is often more useful than a traditional graph of a function. Note that for finite domains, finding an algebraic formula that gives the output for any input is often impossible. Of course we could use a piecewise defined function, like f ( x ) |   x + 1 if x | 1 x − 1 if x | 2 x if x | 3 .
